gspot 0.1.0 · [Source definition](https://github.com/stefanionescu/gspot/blob/main/packages/cli/src/program.ts)

Run checks over the selected files and folders and print findings.

```text
gspot check [options] [paths...]
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Meaning  |
| -------- | -------- |
| `paths`  | optional |

## Options

| Flag                 | Meaning                                                                                |
| -------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--version`          | Print the version and nothing else                                                     |
| `--json`             | Print the documented JSON object instead of text                                       |
| `--quiet`            | Print failures only                                                                    |
| `--verbose`          | Print every command with its arguments and every ignore with its reason                |
| `--no-color`         | No color in the output                                                                 |
| `-C <dir>`           | Run as if started in that directory                                                    |
| `--only <checks...>` | Run the named checks                                                                   |
| `--staged`           | The commit stage over staged files, as the pre-commit hook runs it                     |
| `--changed [ref]`    | Changed paths from the upstream or default branch; use --changed=<ref> to choose a ref |
| `--fix`              | Run every fixer in order, then the checks again                                        |
| `--dry-run`          | With --fix, print the diff of every fix and write nothing                              |
| `--stage <stage>`    | One stage (choices: "commit", "push", "manual")                                        |
| `--skip <checks...>` | Skip the named checks for this run                                                     |
| `--no-cache`         | Run every check even when its inputs are unchanged                                     |
| `-h, --help`         | display help for command                                                               |
